ticket.title: Every repo has empty verification_commands, so storypole verify runs nothing and records a manual receipt
acceptance_criteria: AUDIT 2026-11-06 (config accuracy
after migration). Measured across the ten repos plus the suite root.\n\nCORRECT: ticket_prefix is distinct and right everywhere - RB DA CH SP MTR JN BA OF SH BW
root GB. claim_ttl_minutes is 60 everywhere.\n\nHOLE 1 - verification_commands is [] in all eleven configs
so storypole verify executes nothing and records verifier: manual. The completion gate is decorative
which is precisely the gap AGENTS.md Tier 2/3 assumes is filled. Recommended per repo: [["fmt"
"cargo fmt --all -- --check"]
["clippy"
"cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings"]
["tests"
"cargo nextest run --workspace"]
["docs"

"chalkline docs check -d <repo>"]] with the repo name substituted; root gets the GB-wide equivalents (--workspace / miter contracts / outfeed lockfiles / chalkline docs check --workspace). NOTE the field is Vec<(String
String)>

so the TOML shape is an array of two-element arrays - confirm against the deserialiser before writing eleven files.\n\nHOLE 2 - allowed_repos is [] in nine repos and ["storypole"] in one. Empty means unrestricted (config.rs:101 skips the check entirely when empty)
so this is not a bug but it is not a policy either: nine repos accept work scoped to any repository. Recommendation: member repos scope to themselves (["<repo>"])

matching storypole and matching how each repo stands alone per law 2; the suite root stays unrestricted because that is where cross-repo work is filed. allowed_crates is [] everywhere and appears unenforced - decide whether to populate or retire it.\n\nFIX AT THE GENERATOR
not by hand: storypole_cli workspace_cmds.rs:82 already writes allowed_repos: vec![member.name.clone()] when scaffolding members
so the writer is the right place to emit accurate values. Eleven hand-edits would drift again on the next scaffold.
